item.title: Jackson Fire Department provided resource information to homeless
item.description: JACKSON, Tenn. – Members of the Jackson Fire Department spent part of the cold morning on Saturday, January 24, checking in on those who are homeless in the city. item.description: JACKSON, Tenn. – The Jackson Fire Department has fitted its fleet with chains.
